item.name: Auth
item.description: All user authentication endpoints grouped by flow.

item.name: Flow 1 — Sign Up & Email Verification
item.description:
New user registers, then verifies their email.
Step 1 → Step 2 (or Step 3 if they need to resend).

request.description:
Register a new local user.

Required: email, password, confirmPassword, acceptTerms (true)
Optional: name, phone

Returns a JWT immediately. A verification email is sent in the background.

variable.description: Raw token from the verification email link

request.description: Verify the user's email using the token sent in the verification email.

Resend the email verification link.
Always responds with success even if the email does not exist (anti-enumeration).

item.name: Flow 2 — Login
item.description: Existing user logs in with email/password or Google.

request.description:
Login with email & password (local accounts only).
Returns a JWT.

Login via Google using a Firebase ID token.
The token can also be sent as: Authorization: Bearer <token>

Returns a Kuba JWT plus the user's Google profile (uid, email, name, picture).

Stateless logout — token invalidation is handled client-side by discarding the JWT.
Requires: Bearer token

item.name: Flow 3 — Forgot Password (not logged in)
item.description:
User forgot their password and needs to reset it.
Step 1 → Step 2 → Step 3 (must be done in order).

request.description:
Send a 6-digit OTP to the user's email.
OTP is valid for 10 minutes.
Always responds with success even for unknown or Google accounts (anti-enumeration).

Verify the OTP received by email.

Required: email, otp (6-digit code)

On success returns a short-lived resetToken — pass it in Step 3.
The OTP is consumed and cannot be reused.

Set a new password using the resetToken from Step 2.
The token is passed in the URL and is valid for 10 minutes.

Returns a new JWT — user is logged in immediately after reset.
